tasks.title: Design Encryption Logic
tasks.description: Define the logic for a simple encryption algorithm, such as Caesar Cipher or XOR, including the requirements for both encryption and decryption processes.

tasks.title: Develop Python Encryption Module
tasks.description: Implement the designed algorithm in a Python script. Create functions for 'encrypt' and 'decrypt' that handle string inputs and return the processed text.

tasks.title: Review and Test Module
tasks.description: Conduct a code review to ensure efficiency and security. Run test cases with various strings and keys to verify that decrypting an encrypted string returns the original value.
